detail.title: Future-Ready Workforce Strategies and Matching Skills Model: The Energy Transition Case

publicationDetails.detailsText: C.D. Howe Institute working paper | September 2025

detail.abstract:
• This paper presents a Future-Ready Workforce Strategy, with a Matching Skills model to address mismatches and guide reskilling in times of major economic transitions. It shows that aligning labour market intelligence, training, and transition pathways to support displaced workers can promote lifelong learning and help position Canada as an industry leader following major shifts.
  • In the case of the transition to a lower-carbon economy, studied here, most Canadian workers already possess many transferable skills, with minor gaps in technical knowledge, critical thinking, and problem-solving. Such occupational compatibility enables smoother transitions, especially in sectors like wind, nuclear, hydrogen energy, logistics, biomass processing, and metal refining.
  • At the federal level, Employment and Social Development Canada (ESDC) should enhance intelligence gathering through its Occupational and Skills Information System (OaSIS) program to reflect emerging occupations, build a comprehensive skills database, and create tailored, sector-specific training programs through strong industry-academic partnerships.

This report unveils a new model for matching skills to jobs in Canada in periods of transition. It maps how workers can shift into emerging green industries – ensuring the best use of skills as the country’s economy grows sustainably.

title: The Patent Examiner Sweepstakes
affiliations: University of Georgia - C. Herman and Mary Virginia Terry College of Business

detail.title: The Patent Examiner Sweepstakes
detail.abstract: Prior work analyzed firm growth as a function of review by "easy" examiners who grant patents at a high rate. The current research looks past whether a patent is granted and instead focuses on how assignment to an "easy" or "hard" examiner influences the attributes of resultant patents. Focusing on their propensities to reject applications on novelty or obviousness grounds, analysis finds that patents issued by lenient examiners tend to be broader in scope, are more valuable to their owners, and elicit a larger stock market response when granted. Further analysis quantifies the level of variation ("noise") among examiners. This inquiry finds that the noise level in issuing novelty rejections decreases with examiner experience, while variation among examiners issuing obviousness rejections actually increases with experience. A third line of investigation presents evidence that "stricter" examiners disproportionately reach the correct examination relative to more lenient counterparts. This conclusion is supported by "twin application" analysis comparing outcomes of related U.S. and European applications. Consistent with the literature using this method, the European Patent Office's outcome is considered the "gold standard" for examination, and thus, its decision to grant or deny is assumed correct.

title: CHESS: Continuous Heterogeneity Estimation for Self-Selection into Treatment Using Willingness-to-Pay

detail.title: CHESS: Continuous Heterogeneity Estimation for Self-Selection into Treatment Using Willingness-to-Pay
detail.abstract: In many settings, individuals choose whether to receive a treatment, but experimental designs often ignore this self-selection. This paper introduces a method—Continuous Heterogeneity Estimation for Self-Selection (CHESS)—that uses incentive-compatible willingness-to-pay elicitation to estimate treatment effect heterogeneity as a function of selection propensity. Unlike prior approaches that incorporate binary participant choice into the experimental design (e.g., PICA), CHESS enables estimation of continuous, non-linear heterogeneity and avoids sensitivity to researcher-supplied alternatives to treatment. In a preregistered online experiment with 812 respondents, I use CHESS to study gun control issue advertisements. An anti-gun control ad reduces support for gun control by 0.27 standard deviations, while a pro-gun control ad increases issue priority by 0.26 standard deviations among the respondents most likely to view it. This proof-of-concept demonstrates that CHESS provides a flexible framework for analyzing heterogeneity when self-selection is central to treatment assignment.

title: Responsible AI in Marketing: AI Booing and AI Washing Cycle of AI Mistrust
affiliations: School of Business and Economics, Linnaeus University and Bahcesehir University

detail.title: Responsible AI in Marketing: AI Booing and AI Washing Cycle of AI Mistrust
detail.abstract: The growing integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in marketing has introduced both opportunities and challenges, particularly concerning consumer trust. This paper critically examines two emerging phenomena: AI Washing, where companies exaggerate AI capabilities for marketing advantage, and AI Booing, a public backlash fueled by unmet expectations, ethical concerns, and transparency issues. By analyzing the interplay between these opposing forces, we explore the cyclical nature of AI mistrust and its implications for responsible AI adoption in marketing. Through a review of existing literature and industry examples, this study identifies key ethical, operational, and regulatory challenges in AIdriven marketing strategies. Our findings call attention to the need for transparency, human agency, stakeholder collaboration, and ethical data management to foster responsible AI practices that align with consumer trust and regulatory expectations. We conclude with recommendations for marketing professionals and policymakers to mitigate the cycle of AI mistrust and establish more credible AI integrations in marketing.

title: Do Baby Bonuses Increase Fertility? Evidence From Michigan

detail.title: Do Baby Bonuses Increase Fertility? Evidence From Michigan
detail.abstract: This paper measures the fertility effects of the first baby bonus introduced in Michigan, which is the first baby bonus introduced in the United States. We find that birth growth rates increased significantly in the treated region during the first year of the policy compared to control regions. We also present a version of the Barro-Becker model with a baby bonus.

title: The Responses of Physicians to a Fall in Demand for Voluntary Private Health Insurance
affiliations: Monash University, University of Melbourne - Melbourne Institute: Applied Economic & Social Research and University of Melbourne - Melbourne Institute: Applied Economic & Social Research

detail.title: The Responses of Physicians to a Fall in Demand for Voluntary Private Health Insurance

publicationDetails.journalName: Melbourne Institute of Applied Economic and Social Research Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper examines the impact of a fall in demand for voluntary private health insurance on physician behaviour. We find that dual practice physicians who earned more revenue from working in private hospitals before the fall in demand for PHI were more likely to experience a fall in the volume of private hospital care and a less complex mix of in-hospital services provided. Risk-averse doctors drove this reduction in complexity. There was weak evidence suggesting that doctors compensated for the fall in volume by increasing their working hours in public hospitals and reducing fees for in-hospital services. We found no evidence of higher volumes of care in out-of-hospital visits to compensate for the lower in-hospital volumes, but some weak evidence of claiming for more complex and costly out-of-hospital services, which we interpret as upcoding. Compensatory behaviours were small and primarily observed among riskaverse male doctors with low conscientiousness, from non-surgical specialties, and located in areas with lower doctor density.

title: Cities and Digital Twins: The Importance of Data Governance and Collaboration
affiliations: and The GovLab

detail.title: Cities and Digital Twins: The Importance of Data Governance and Collaboration

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have received no funding for this work and that no third-party organisation has influenced the research, analysis, or conclusions presented in this concept note.

detail.abstract:
Digital twins are gaining prominence in cities and other domains, yet their usefulness depends less on advanced visualization than on the governance of data that feeds them. This paper examines lessons from projects such as Virtual Singapore, Orlando’s holographic prototype, Helsinki’s Climate Atlas, Bologna’s Civic Digital Twin, Europe’s Destination Earth, and private initiatives like Fujitsu/Tsuda. Across contexts, the main challenge is not technical capability but the ability to access, share and steward data responsibly.

We propose a pragmatic 4Ps framework Purpose, Principles, Processes and Practices — to anchor digital twins in sound data governance. They are mutually reinforcing and help to move from abstract to sustainable data governance. Our approach links legal and policy tools with collaborative practice, integrating concepts of Digital Self-Determination and AI Localism so that rights, participation and accountability are built into agreements, standards and operational routines.

Our contribution shows that technology is only half the equation. Equally important is creating a framework that allows data to flow responsibly across boundaries and be applied in a manner that aligns with public values. The next generation of digital twins will thrive only if we build them on principles of openness, fairness, and shared purpose. The task is one of turning data into a public problem-solving tool. A digital twin should be viewed not as a technical artifact, but as a living, evolving data collaborative that brings together many partners to improve their city.

detail.title: Adversity of young female domestic workers in the Middle East: the case of returnees in Mekaneselam town: South Wollo
detail.abstract: The problem of young female migration is a phenomenon that touches on a variety of economic, political, social and cultural aspects, influencing peoples in the globalized world. More than ever before, it touches all peoples in the time of increasing globalization. This study employed a qualitative method, specifically interpretative phenomenology for deep understanding of the issue under study. The researcher employed 12 in-depth interview participants, six key informants and two FGD groups.The findings of this study revealed that: Poverty, unemployment, conflict, violence and hopelessness as the major motivating factors of young females to migrate to the Middle East, and also sexual abuse, religious abuse, psychological abuse, cheating, payment inequality, physical abuse, inadequate job options and cultural challenges were the major challenges of female migrants in the destination. Separation of their marital partner and problem of rehabilitation were the other challenges of migrants after they returned to their country. This study showed that families, government, religious institutions and non-governmental organizations did not adequately prepare to rehabilitate migrant returnees. In general, this study concluded, religious disparity, gender, racial and ethnic differences as the major sources of young females burden in the Middle East.In line with the findings the researcher recommend that: The legal brokers as well as some destination embassies should work in accordance with the existing rules and guidelines; in addition to this the concerned bodies, like religious institutions, political institutions, social institutions and charity organizations should work cooperatively in order to reduce the challenges of both documented and undocumented migrants after and before their migration.

title: Should the Public be Concerned about Congressional Stock Trading?
affiliations: Carnegie Mellon University - David A. Tepper School of Business, Rice University - Jesse H. Jones Graduate School of Business and

detail.title: Should the Public be Concerned about Congressional Stock Trading?
detail.abstract: We study whether trades made by members of Congress outperform by combining survey-elicited beliefs with a hierarchical Bayesian model of abnormal returns. While prior literature finds little evidence of average outperformance, we show that profitable trading does occur but is infrequent and concentrated during key periods. Survey respondents believe two-thirds of members trade on private information, with expected profits of 36% per informed trade. Our model estimates that the vast majority of traders occasionally make profitable trades, but such trades are quite rare. We find no evidence that conflicted trades are more profitable, contrary to such trades' media scrutiny. Consistent with proposed policy changes, trades in funds are less likely to be informed than single-stock trades.

title: Stakeholder-Informed Environmental-Economic Tradeoffs at the Farm and Forest Scale

detail.title: Stakeholder-Informed Environmental-Economic Tradeoffs at the Farm and Forest Scale
detail.abstract: Agriculture and silviculture are economically and culturally important across broad regions of the world that rely on groundwater resources. However, these practices consume water and can be sources of nonpoint source pollution, affecting water quantity and quality in the aquifer and associated ecosystems. Specific management practices (MP) applied at the farm- and forest-scale substantially influence aquifer recharge and nitrate leaching and have the potential to reduce environmental impacts. However, MP implementation is often associated with high producer costs, potentially reducing their economic viability. Rigorously quantifying the environmental and economic tradeoffs of MP implementation is thus critical for developing policies to support and incentivize their adoption. In this study, we engaged with a broad community of stakeholders in a participatory modeling process to develop and assess a range of MP and enterprise budgets for corn, peanut, carrot, hay, pasture-raised cattle, and plantation pine in the Floridan Aquifer region of the southeastern United States, focused here on Florida. We used the Soil and Water Assessment Tool (SWAT) to simulate groundwater recharge, nitrate leaching, and crop/forest yields. Economic analyses used enterprise budgets informed by SWAT yield outputs to compute net producer returns, and results were compared within a 3-dimensional tradeoff space (aquifer recharge-nitrate load-net financial returns). Results indicated clear synergies and tradeoffs among production systems, with row crops having the highest economic benefit and largest environmental impacts, while pine and forage production systems had smaller economic benefits but lower environmental impacts. Importantly, improved MP dramatically reduced environmental impacts while in some cases achieving higher net returns. These observations suggest that improved MP can improve both the environmental and economic sustainability of agricultural and silvicultural production in the Floridan Aquifer region, a finding with relevance for similar agricultural regions globally.

detail.title: Multihoming and Single-homing Complementors' Responses to Intensified Between-Platform Competition: Evidence from the YouTube-Twitch Rivalry
detail.abstract: This paper examines how heterogeneous YouTube content creators, specifically single-homing and multihoming channels, respond to a sudden increase in the exposure of the rival platform, Twitch. Contrary to expectations, I find that multihoming channels reduce their content creation efforts and underperform relative to single-homers. To make sense of these surprising results, I develop a formal model that characterizes the strategic behavior of different types of complementors operating across two platforms with varying levels of user exposure. The model offers a plausible explanation for the observed empirical patterns, suggesting that intensified competition between platforms, as a consequence of their changing exposure, disproportionately incentivizes single-homers to enhance platform value while discouraging multihomers from maintaining the same level of engagement.

detail.title: The Integration of E, S, and G into ESG: Consumer Awareness, Supply Chains, and the Role of Governance

publicationDetails.detailsText: KAIST College of Business Working Paper Series No. KCB-WP-2025-007

detail.abstract:
ESG is a key concept in business and the economy these days. However, ESG is a combination of seemingly distinct constructs. For decades, environmental responsibility (E), social justice (S), and corporate governance (G) developed as different domains of research, policy, and practice. Environmentalism focused on climate change, pollution, and biodiversity loss. Social activists looked into social responsibility and justice issues in such areas as labor rights, inequality, and protections for marginalized groups globally. Governance scholarship concentrated on shareholder rights, fiduciary duties, and corporate accountability. Despite extensive governmental and NGO interventions, systemic progress on environmental and social objectives remained limited. This observation raises the question of why ESG integration has only become a central paradigm in the past two decades.

This paper argues that the integration of E, S, and G into ESG reflects not merely normative convergence but a structural transformation of markets. Three forces underpin this transformation. First, consumer awareness must act as a market mechanism that restructures corporate incentives, forcing firms to move beyond regulatory compliance toward proactive ESG engagement. Second, supply chains have to be the systemic arena where environmental degradation and social injustice intersect, and corporations hold leverage to implement meaningful solutions. Third, governance should be the conduit through which consumer and investor pressures are translated into enforceable corporate practices, thereby aligning market behavior with sustainability goals.

Insights from stakeholder theory, global value chain analysis, and governance literature enable us to conceptualize ESG as an irreversible trajectory. It is about to redefine corporate legitimacy, competitiveness, and responsibility. This paper contributes to theory by reframing ESG as a structural market shift, not a simple extension of corporate social responsibility. We suggest implications for managers, investors, and policymakers in designing strategies integrating consumer awareness, supply chain leverage, and governance reforms into coherent ESG practices.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨ESG整合成为核心范式的原因，认为ESG反映了市场结构转型而非简单的规范趋同，由消费者意识、供应链杠杆和治理改革三大力量驱动。

AI.theory_contributions: 将ESG重新定义为结构性市场转变，而非企业社会责任的简单延伸

title: The Equitable Financial Inclusion Score (EFIS): A Microeconomic Framework for Credit Assessment in Underserved Populations
affiliations: Columbia University - Columbia Business School and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The Equitable Financial Inclusion Score (EFIS): A Microeconomic Framework for Credit Assessment in Underserved Populations
detail.abstract: Traditional credit scoring breaks down for 1.4 billion people worldwide. These aren't bad risks. They're invisible risks. The problem is information asymmetry. Banks can't see their potential because the data they need doesn't exist in the formats that traditional models expect. We built the Equitable Financial Inclusion Score (EFIS) to solve this problem. EFIS uses four mathematical components: human capital assessment through Kalman filtering, social capital quantification via network theory, reputation signaling through gametheoretic mechanisms, and behavioral profiling using time preference estimation. The result is a transparent, mathematically rigorous framework that transforms excluded populations into visible, scoreable risks.

detail.title: Potential Changes to the Taxation of Carried Interests in Commercial Real Estate

publicationDetails.journalName: Chicago Booth: Fama-Miller Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper examines the impact of increasing the tax rate applied to carried (or promoted) interests in the context of U.S. commercial real estate investing. Under current tax law, this disproportionate share of cash flow distributions is typically taxed at the capital-gain tax rate rather than at the ordinary-income tax rate. This carried interest “loophole” remains a contentious political issue. The literature is divided; some advance arguments for taxing carried interest at ordinary income rates, while other research defends the current tax treatment. However, no research of which we are aware has attempted to quantify the benefit of this favorable tax treatment to commercial real estate investors, especially general partners. We attempt to fill this gap in the literature. Due to the complexities of the Tax Code, no closed-form solution is available; instead, a detailed financial model is constructed. The paper relies on two metrics to quantify the impacts of changing tax rates: the effective tax rate and arc elasticities. Our primary findings can be summarized as follows. The GP’s effective tax rate for the base case scenario is 12.32%, which is 4.75 percentage points lower than the LPs’ effective tax rate of 17.07%. However, if the GP’s “pure” carried interest is taxed at a 40% instead of 23.8%, the GP’s effective tax rate increases by 6.85 percentage points to 19.17%. The average arc elasticities of after-tax returns with respect to changes in the assumed capital gains rates are greater – in absolute value – for the LPs than for the GP. In other words, efforts to increase the capital gains rate to something approaching the ordinary-income rates would be more detrimental to the after-tax returns of the LPs than the GP. Should new legislation produce an increase in the capital gains rate, myopic LPs and/or GPs might favor increasing leverage and/or investing in riskier properties to offset the negative effects of legislative action.

detail.title: Electrifying Empowerment: Women Role Models and Solar Electrification in Rural Myanmar
detail.abstract: External constraints such as social and political structures and market failures hinder marginalized groups' prospects for a better life by restricting their choice sets and limiting access to basic public services, like electricity. Moreover, such forces do not operate independently of internal constraints. In many settings, gender norms relegate women to domestic roles, which, in turn, may erode their sense of agency across many life domains and lower their aspirations. This may further discourage them from pursuing fruitful opportunities, including those related to investments in energy services that could ease their disproportionate burden from household work and raise their productive potential. We ran a randomized control trial in the states of Ayeyarwady and Tanintharyi of Myanmar to test a psychological empowerment intervention that combines an edutainment component with a series of visualization, goal setting and planning exercises drawn from motivational psychology. The treatment has the goal of increasing women's sense of agency and encouraging the setting of higher aspirations, including around energy access, as well as providing participants with a blueprint to pursue them effectively. The intervention was highly successful at raising women's empowerment, particularly on dimensions (financial and business agency) most salient in the story. We only see impacts on aspirations in unelectrified villages, where we find positive effects on a novel measure of aspirations for productive appliances and a large increase on aspirations for children's education. In these villages, we also see a parallel increase in education expenditures, the time women spend on childcare, and the probability that households took out a business loan. These effects are driven by the same women who show the biggest changes in aspirations for children's education (the more ambitious and educated women), which suggests that the perceived feasibility and value of the underlying goals may determine which subgroup and dimensions of aspirations respond to the intervention.

detail.title: Battery Talent Census: Skills, Training, and Growth Insights from 1,000 Battery Professionals
detail.abstract: The battery industry has become foundational to the global energy transition and a linchpin of U.S. industrial competitiveness. The lithium-ion battery chain is positioned for extraordinary growth, potentially reaching a value of more than $400 billion by 2030. Beyond electric mobility and grid storage, new frontiers, ranging from electric aviation to AI data centers and defense, further amplify the strategic importance of batteries in the coming decades. Realizing the growth potential of the battery industry, however, requires addressing a fundamental constraint: talent shortages. The battery industry's rate of expansion is directly limited by workforce availability. Advancing ongoing conversations around workforce planning requires a clear understanding of the current state of the workforce. Until now, conversations about battery talent gaps have been dominated by anecdotes and fragmented surveys. The Battery Talent Census, based on responses from over 1,000 industry professionals, provides the most comprehensive, data-driven snapshot of skilled knowledge workers powering the battery sector to date. This report presents the full results of the Census, covering everything from demographic insights on today's battery professionals to the skills and roles most in demand, evolving compensation and retention dynamics, and how students view their future career pathways. Recognizing that different audiences will prioritize different insights, we distill our key findings and recommendations into four stakeholder groups: educational institutions and content creators; students and job seekers; battery company leaders and recruiters; and policymakers.

detail.abstract: Transformation in societal systems such as food systems is required to overcome global crises. An essential part of stewarding desirable transformations is for organizations and initiatives to develop understanding of whether such transformations are occurring, their contributions (both potential and actual) to transformation, and the impacts of transformations already underway, as well as maintaining capacity for agility and adaptation. These are fundamentally issues of evaluation – the process of assigning quality, value or importance to something – that enables learning about transformations. However, the movement towards transformation-focused evaluation is a relatively recent chapter in the evolution of the evaluation field, a major and challenging departure from mainstream evaluation practice, and lacking in case studies of its design and application. Here we provide a rare insight into the collaborative process of designing, and starting to implement and embed, transformation-focused evaluation in the context of a large regional-scale food system transformation initiative, Food for the Future in North Yorkshire. We present the transformation-focused evaluation and learning system designed for the initiative, which shows how core evaluation questions, goals and guides, and different forms of feedback, sense-making and learning could be integrated and reinforce each other within an ecosystem of actors striving to support food system transformation. We discuss the innovations, progress and challenges in the framework and its application, as well as our lessons more broadly for the growing number of organizations and initiatives interested in using transformation-focused evaluation to support large-scale system transformation.

title: Policing Strategies, Crime Control, and Drug Policies: A Synthesis of the Empirical Evidence

detail.title: Policing Strategies, Crime Control, and Drug Policies: A Synthesis of the Empirical Evidence
detail.abstract: This paper presents a synthesis of the contemporary empirical literature on the effectiveness of various policing and crime control strategies. It examines multiple approaches, from "broken windows" policing and "hot spots" targeting, to the controversial "kingpin strategy" in the fight against drug trafficking in Latin America. Additionally, it explores economic analyses of illicit crop eradication and substitution policies, harm reduction interventions from a public health perspective, and the role of intelligence and judicial oversight in crime prevention. Finally, it addresses the financial front of criminality, including the regulation of chemical precursors and anti-money laundering policies. By integrating meta-analyses, quasi-experimental studies, and econometric analyses, conclusions are drawn about the effectiveness, unintended consequences, and contextual nuances of these interventions, offering a comprehensive overview of the current evidence to inform future policies and practices. The Theory of Criminogenic Systemic Perturbation (CSP) is proposed as a unifying framework to explain the divergent outcomes of these interventions.

detail.title: State-Dependent Market (In)Efficiency in Cryptocurrency Markets
detail.abstract: Is the inefficiency in cryptocurrency markets constant or state-dependent? We test this using an adaptive framework that learns from novel on-chain and trend-based information. We find an adaptive approach not only yields superior risk-adjusted performance but also significantly reduces downside risk compared to static benchmarks. The source of this outperformance is economically intuitive; the model learns to prioritize behavioral trend signals during volatile regimes and fundamental on-chain metrics during stable periods. This validates these novel information sets as drivers of predictability, providing strong evidence for the Adaptive Market Hypothesis.

title: Incorporating Nature
affiliations: and University of California, Santa Barbara (UCSB) - Donald Bren School of Environmental Science & Management

detail.title: Incorporating Nature
detail.abstract: Over the past decade, businesses have faced unprecedented demands from governments and stakeholders to account for the risks they face from climate change as well as their firms' impacts on climate. These very same demands have begun--in fits and starts--to focus on natural capital. Public and private efforts to incorporate nature into business decisions across the globe are advancing rapidly and significantly yet remain ignored in law reviews. This Essay explains and analyzes these new developments, which closely mirror the "climate playbook" through monitoring, disclosure, and target-setting requirements. While following the climate playbook for natural capital may seem appealing, it presents distinct challenges. Unlike greenhouse gas emissions--globally fungible and uniform in impact--natural capital is non-fungible, varying across time, space, and type. Accounting for natural capital therefore imposes inherent tradeoffs. To avoid the risks of performative compliance and potential backlash, the Essay proposes a path forward grounded in bottom-up reporting and public participation to establish goals and assess tradeoffs.

title: Learning When to Restart: Nonstationary Newsvendor from Uncensored to Censored Demand
affiliations: Georgia Institute of Technology - H. Milton Stewart School of Industrial and Systems Engineering, Fudan University, Chinese University of Hong Kong and Tsinghua University - Yau Mathematical Sciences Center

detail.title: Learning When to Restart: Nonstationary Newsvendor from Uncensored to Censored Demand
detail.abstract: We study nonstationary newsvendor problems under nonparametric demand models and general distributional measures of nonstationarity, addressing the practical challenges of unknown degree of nonstationarity and demand censoring. We propose a novel distributional-detection-and-restart framework for learning in nonstationary environments, and instantiate it through two efficient algorithms for the uncensored and censored demand settings. The algorithms are fully adaptive, requiring no prior knowledge of the degree and type of nonstationarity, and offer a flexible yet powerful approach to handling both abrupt and gradual changes in nonstationary environments. We establish a comprehensive optimality theory for our algorithms by deriving matching regret upper and lower bounds under both general and refined structural conditions with nontrivial proof techniques that are of independent interest. Numerical experiments using real-world datasets, including nurse staffing data for emergency departments and COVID-19 test demand data, showcase the algorithms' superior and robust empirical performance. While motivated by the newsvendor problem, the distributional-detection-and-restart framework applies broadly to a wide class of nonstationary stochastic optimization problems. Managerially, our framework provides a practical, easy-to-deploy, and theoretically grounded solution for decision-making under nonstationarity.

The framework links AI literacy with existing curriculum strands such as history, geography, civics, economics, Sociology and Pakistan Studies. It also highlights the importance of teacher training, infrastructure, and policy guidelines to ensure equitable access and ethical practice. By connecting global trends in AI education with local realities of Sindh, the paper provides a roadmap for embedding AI into education in ways that prepare students for the digital age while strengthening their civic and ethical understanding.

detail.title: Bridging Realms: Western Client Perspectives on Psychotherapy Inspired by Indigenous Healing

declarations.ethicsApproval: The study was approved by the Ethics Committee of the Prague College of Psychosocial Studies.

detail.abstract: Context: The decolonial turn in psychology criticizes conventional Western psychotherapeutic frameworks and seeks to decolonize therapeutic practices by considering diverse cultural perspectives. Indigenous healing has been increasingly used in the psychotherapy of ethnic communities, but also in the psychotherapy of Western clients. The research questions of the present study were focused on how Western clients experience the therapies inspired by Indigenous healing. Objective: The study aimed to explore the motivations, experiences, and mental health outcomes of participants of therapies inspired by Indigenous healing with a focus on issues related to intercultural transfer of therapeutic practice. Design: Semi-structured qualitative interviews were used to gather narratives from 28 participants. Thematic analysis was used for data analysis. Results: Participants reported the following long-lasting outcomes of Indigenous therapies: increased well-being, calm, satisfaction with life, better emotion regulation, coping with stress, behavioral control, problem solving, decision making as well as a more sensitive and deeper experience of reality. Conventional Western psychotherapy was perceived as conversationbased, while Indigenous therapy was perceived as experience-based and more complex. The integration of experiences from Indigenous therapies was more difficult in the Western sociocultural environment compared to participation in the place of their origin, within the community of Indigenous people. Conclusion: Indigenous healing has beneficial outcomes for Western clients, but the integration of these experiences is quite difficult and requires systematic psychotherapeutic support in the Western cultural environment.

title: Rethinking Psychedelic REMS

detail.title: Rethinking Psychedelic REMS
detail.abstract: FDA REMS and ETASU for psychedelic therapy—psilocybin, MDMA, and Spravato (esketamine)—can enhance safety yet impose clinic-only administration that limits access. Using Spravato’s REMS as precedent, this Article shows how “every-use” in-person supervision and limited distribution increase cost and strain providers even as adverse events cluster early in treatment. It proposes a patient-centered gradual release REMS: intensive oversight at initiation then calibrated step-down via take-home dosing, telehealth supervision, provider certification, and patient registries that generate real-world evidence. The model aligns with §505-1 and 21 U.S.C. § 355-1, which require ETASU to be necessary, proportionate to risk, and not unduly burdensome. It details REMS modification and burden analysis, sponsor–FDA negotiation with CDER/DRISK, diversion and misconduct safeguards, emergency protocols, and payer coverage considerations. Comparisons to COVID-era methadone take-home flexibilities and graduated licensing in U.S. skydiving illustrate how staged privileges can preserve safety while expanding equitable access. The Article offers concrete levers for REMS assessment reports, postmarket commitments, and data capture to support iterative ETASU updates, and maps an implementation path that maintains safety, reduces cost, and improves health-system fit for psychedelic-assisted psychotherapy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种以患者为中心的渐进式REMS模型，用于迷幻药治疗（如psilocybin、MDMA和Spravato），通过分阶段减少监管强度来平衡安全性与可及性。

detail.abstract: The integration of artificial intelligence (AI) in project management gained significant attention for its potential to enhance decision-making, optimize resource allocation, and streamline workflows. This study explored the applicability of AI across various stages of a project's lifecycle, focusing on its impact on business planning, project initiation, execution, and monitoring. Through targeted survey responses, we assessed how AI-driven tools assisted in key project management functions, including scope definition, work breakdown structure (WBS) development, scheduling, and risk identification. Additionally, we examined AI's limitations, such as data freshness, contextual understanding, and decision-making biases, which influenced user perceptions of AI effectiveness. The findings indicated that while AI significantly improved efficiency in structured tasks, challenges remained in areas requiring deep expert knowledge, contextual adaptability, and human-like reasoning. The study also highlighted the role of machine learning (ML) models in improving project tracking, predictive analytics, and adaptive decision-making. Furthermore, we proposed a Project Manager's Intelligent Assistant (PMIA) as an AI-powered framework designed to assist project managers in complex decision-making processes. The PMIA model integrated historical project data, real-time analytics, and AI-driven recommendations to enhance project success. However, ethical considerations, potential biases, and the need for human oversight remained critical challenges in AI-driven project management. By addressing these gaps, this research provided insights into the future role of AI in project management, emphasizing the balance between automation and human expertise to maximize project outcomes.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了人工智能在项目管理全生命周期中的应用，包括其对业务规划、项目启动、执行和监控的影响。研究发现AI在结构化任务中显著提升效率，但在需要深度专业知识和情境适应性的领域仍存在挑战。研究提出了项目管理者智能助手(PMIA)框架，并强调了AI驱动项目管理中的伦理考量和人类监督的重要性。

AI.motivation: 人工智能在项目管理中的整合因其提升决策质量、优化资源分配和简化工作流程的潜力而受到广泛关注。研究旨在探索AI在整个项目生命周期中的适用性及其对项目管理实践的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于项目管理生命周期理论、人工智能应用理论、机器学习模型理论，以及人机协作框架。
AI.method: 通过有针对性的问卷调查，评估AI驱动工具在关键项目管理功能（如范围定义、工作分解结构开发、进度安排和风险识别）中的辅助作用。
AI.findings: AI在结构化任务中显著提高效率，但在需要深度专业知识、情境适应性和类人推理的领域仍面临挑战。机器学习模型在项目跟踪、预测分析和自适应决策方面表现良好。

AI.practical_contributions: 为项目管理实践提供了AI应用的具体指导；强调了伦理考量和人类监督的重要性；为开发更有效的AI驱动项目管理工具提供了实践框架。

title: The Impact of Non-Financial Rewards on Employee Innovation, with an Emphasis on the Moderating Effects of Individualistic and Collectivist Cultures and the Mediating Function of Employee Engagement
affiliations: NATIONAL ELECTRONIC MEDIA INSTITUTE OF SOUTH AFRICA and IIE Rosebank College

detail.title: The Impact of Non-Financial Rewards on Employee Innovation, with an Emphasis on the Moderating Effects of Individualistic and Collectivist Cultures and the Mediating Function of Employee Engagement
detail.abstract: Purpose: This paper aims to examine the impact of non-financial rewards on employee innovation, with an emphasis on the moderating effects of individualistic and collectivist cultures as well as the mediating function of employee engagement. Design/Methodology: Quantitative data analysis was performed using the Analysis of Moment Structures (AMOS) to demonstrate the conceptual framework through Structural Equation Model (SEM) analysis, which utilized the study's relevant descriptive and inferential tests. Findings: Non-financial benefits significantly enhance employee engagement, which in turn moderates their impact on employee innovation. Individualistic versus collectivist cultural contexts have an impact on the effectiveness of reward systems; collectivist cultures exhibit higher levels of engagement, but for optimal innovative results, rewards must align with cultural ideals. Practical Implications: By combining the Job Demands-Resources (JD-R) model with Self-Determination Theory (SDT), this study makes a theoretical contribution by elucidating how psychological involvement converts rewards into innovative behaviours. Practically, this study emphasises the necessity of non-financial rewards, culturally appropriate reward systems that prioritize equity, acknowledgment, and opportunities for growth. It also emphasises how crucial it is to match employee values with organisational culture to maximize engagement and innovation.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨非财务奖励对员工创新的影响，重点分析个人主义与集体主义文化的调节作用以及员工敬业度的中介机制。研究发现非财务奖励通过提升员工敬业度促进创新，且奖励效果受文化背景显著影响。

AI.motivation: 理解非财务奖励对员工创新的作用机制，以及文化背景如何影响奖励系统的有效性，为企业设计更有效的激励体系提供理论依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合工作要求-资源（JD-R）模型与自我决定理论（SDT），构建非财务奖励通过心理参与转化为创新行为的理论框架。
AI.method: 采用结构方程模型（SEM）进行定量数据分析，使用AMOS软件进行描述性和推断性统计检验。
AI.findings: 非财务奖励显著提升员工敬业度，进而促进创新；集体主义文化下员工敬业度更高，但奖励效果需与文化价值观匹配才能达到最佳创新效果。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献在于整合JD-R模型和SDT理论，阐明心理参与如何将奖励转化为创新行为的内在机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践意义强调非财务奖励的重要性，建议设计符合文化背景的奖励体系，注重公平性、认可度和成长机会，并将员工价值观与组织文化相匹配以最大化敬业度和创新。

title: Building Diversity into the Philosophy and Methodology of Economics with Stratification Economics
affiliations: Utrecht University and Marquette University - Department of Economics

detail.title: Building Diversity into the Philosophy and Methodology of Economics with Stratification Economics
detail.abstract: We argue mainstream economics lacks diversity regarding who produces it and what it is about because its average man, Homo economicus ontological entry-point, obscures social differences between people. To the extent Philosophy and Methodology of Economics (PME) presupposes this entry point it confines itself narrowly to epistemological analysis, and fails to make diversity a fundamental concern. We argue taking diversity seriously requires PME making ontological reasoning central and expanding its normative scope to include such matters as justice and equality. This moves it away from a value-neutral methodological approach with its exclusively welfarist ethical stance toward a critical, value-explicit, open methodological posture. To illustrate how alternative ontological entry-points incorporate social differences, we describe Stratification economics' PME approach. Stratification Economics explains how economies and societies are structured around hierarchical, caste-like structures that rank different people's opportunities and well-being by their social group identity status. This entails a more complex understanding of economic agency, and produces alternative explanations of social interaction in and outside markets. We explain this in micro-level and macro-level terms, and show how together social group relationships structure the economy to produce systems of inclusion and exclusion for people according to their social group status. We conclude by discussing links between pluralism and diversity.

AI.tldr: 主流经济学缺乏多样性，因为其基于Homo economicus的本体论起点掩盖了社会差异。哲学与经济学方法论（PME）需要将本体论推理作为核心，并扩展其规范范围以包含正义和平等等问题，从而从价值中立的方法论转向批判性的、价值明确的方法论立场。分层经济学的PME方法展示了如何通过替代本体论起点来整合社会差异。
AI.research_question: 主流经济学为何缺乏多样性？如何通过哲学与经济学方法论的变革来认真对待多样性问题？
AI.motivation: 主流经济学在生产者和内容方面缺乏多样性，因为其基于Homo economicus的本体论起点掩盖了社会差异，导致PME局限于认识论分析而未能将多样性作为基本关切。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分层经济学（Stratification Economics）的理论框架，强调经济体和社会围绕等级化、种姓式结构组织，根据社会群体身份地位对不同人群的机会和福祉进行排序。
AI.method: 通过本体论推理和规范分析，描述分层经济学的PME方法，从微观和宏观层面解释社会群体关系如何结构化经济体系。
AI.findings: 替代本体论起点能够整合社会差异，产生对市场内外社会互动的替代解释，揭示经济体系如何根据社会群体地位产生包容和排斥系统。
AI.theory_contributions: 将PME从价值中立的方法论转向批判性、价值明确的方法论立场，强调本体论推理的中心地位，扩展规范范围至正义和平等等问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 为经济学领域提供更具包容性的方法论框架，促进对多样性的认真对待，有助于识别和解决经济体系中的不平等和排斥问题。

title: Factors Affecting the Performance of Small, and Medium Enterprises: Evidence from Burao District, Somaliland

detail.title: Factors Affecting the Performance of Small, and Medium Enterprises: Evidence from Burao District, Somaliland

publicationDetails.detailsText: Journal of Innovation and Entrepreneurship | Forthcoming

detail.abstract: Purpose: This study focuses on the factors influencing the performance of SMEs in Burao, Somaliland, where studies related to this topic are limited and scarce. Financial factors, infrastructure factors, technological capability, and government support were examined to test their influence on the performance of SMEs. Methodology: A crosssectional study was employed, and our research design was explanatory and descriptive, with a quantitative approach. A sample of 373 SME owners and managers from the trading, construction, manufacturing, and service sectors was selected using simple random sampling methods. Data were collected through surveys and analyzed using STATA (version 17). The analysis employed descriptive statistics, multicollinearity tests, Pearson's correlation, and regression analysis to assess SME performance and the challenges faced. Findings: The study revealed that SME performance is negatively affected by financial constraints, insufficient government support, inadequate infrastructure, and limited technological capability. Correlation and regression analyses confirmed that these independent variables significantly and moderately influenced SME performance, supporting all hypotheses. Research limitations: This study faced limitations due to the scarcity of literature on factors influencing SME performance in Somaliland, particularly in the Burao District, which restricted comparisons with prior research. Future studies should examine additional factors, such as entrepreneurial orientation and innovation capability, especially in the context of external shocks such as the COVID-19 pandemic. Moreover, in-depth qualitative research using comprehensive interviews with managers is recommended to provide richer insights into the subject. Implications and recommendations: From a practical standpoint, SME managers are encouraged to improve performance by leveraging opportunities such as better access to finance, the adoption of appropriate technologies, and securing affordable electricity, each of which can enhance enterprise operations in different contexts. Government bodies, particularly the Ministry of Trade and Tourism and related agencies, should collaborate to reduce barriers for entrepreneurs by streamlining business registration processes, offering managerial training programs, and providing access to tax exemptions and other supportive policies.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨索马里兰布劳地区中小企业绩效的影响因素，发现财务约束、政府支持不足、基础设施不完善和技术能力有限对中小企业绩效产生负面影响。

title: The Regulation of Technological Innovation in Financial Services: A Comparative Approach with Respect to Digital Assets and Artificial Intelligence
affiliations: Harvard Law School and Goethe-University Frankfurt

detail.title: The Regulation of Technological Innovation in Financial Services: A Comparative Approach with Respect to Digital Assets and Artificial Intelligence
detail.abstract: This article offers a comparative analysis of how the United States and the European Union regulate technological innovation in financial services, with a focus on digital assets and artificial intelligence (AI). The United States relies on a decentralized, bottom-up approach dominated by regulatory agencies that interpret and apply existing statutory frameworks to new technologies, often through enforcement actions and ad hoc rulemaking. Although state legislatures occasionally pioneer innovative regulatory models, federal legislation has been slow to emerge, leading to inconsistent oversight and compliance challenges. Notably, recent passage of the GENIUS Act established a federal framework for stablecoins, but left broader AI and digital asset regulation mainly unresolved at the national level. By contrast, the European Union pursues an anticipatory, top-down strategy, enacting Unionwide regulations and directives—such as MiCAR for digital assets and the Artificial Intelligence Act (AIA) for AI—designed to manage risks before widespread market adoption. While the European offers greater legal certainty and harmonization, enforcement remains fragmented due to Member States’ discretion and varied regulatory cultures, leading to divergent application and effectiveness. Despite these differences, the article identifies emerging areas of transatlantic convergence, including mutual recognition of stablecoin regimes and parallel efforts to address issues like algorithmic bias and market manipulation. The authors conclude that while institutional and philosophical divergences are likely to persist, both jurisdictions are increasingly grappling with similar regulatory challenges posed by technological innovation in finance and may gradually move toward greater substantive alignment.

AI.tldr: 本文比较分析了美国和欧盟在金融服务技术创新监管方面的差异，重点关注数字资产和人工智能领域。美国采用分散化、自下而上的监管方式，而欧盟则采取预期性、自上而下的策略。尽管存在制度差异，但双方在稳定币监管等领域正出现趋同。
AI.research_question: 美国和欧盟在金融服务技术创新（特别是数字资产和人工智能）监管方面存在哪些主要差异和相似之处？
AI.motivation: 随着金融科技创新的快速发展，不同司法管辖区采取了不同的监管方法。理解这些差异对于促进跨境合作和制定有效的监管框架具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 比较监管分析框架，重点关注监管策略（分散化vs集中化）、监管时机（事后vs事前）和监管协调机制。
AI.method: 比较分析法，通过对美国和欧盟监管框架、立法进程、执法机制的系统性对比研究。
AI.findings: 1）美国采用分散化、自下而上的监管方式，依赖现有法规解释和执法行动；2）欧盟采取预期性、自上而下的策略，通过统一法规提前管理风险；3）双方在稳定币监管等领域出现趋同趋势。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了金融服务技术创新监管的比较分析框架，揭示了不同监管哲学对监管效果的影响，为跨国监管协调理论提供了实证基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了美欧监管模式的对比分析，有助于制定更有效的跨境监管合作策略，促进金融科技创新与风险管理的平衡。

title: Operationalizing Systemic Coherence Theory: Empirical Validation of Balantium with Current Risk Detection Suite (CIX) Across Major Financial Crises
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Operationalizing Systemic Coherence Theory: Empirical Validation of Balantium with Current Risk Detection Suite (CIX) Across Major Financial Crises
detail.abstract: This paper presents comprehensive empirical validation of the Current Risk Detection Suite (CIX), a deterministic analytical framework operationalizing the theoretical constructs of systemic resonance, coherence, and feedback introduced in the Balantium framework (Klemarczyk, 2025). Unlike conventional risk models that rely on stochastic assumptions or machine learning approaches, CIX employs field-theoretic transformations to quantify systemic coherence decay as a precursor to financial instability. Through comprehensive backtesting across 25 years of market data encompassing eleven major financial crises-including the 1997 Asian Financial Crisis, the 2010 Flash Crash, the 2018 Volmageddon event, and the 2020 COVID-19 market collapse-CIX demonstrated exceptional predictive performance. The system achieved lead times ranging from 75 to 250 days (mean = 147 days, = 48), Sharpe ratios between 1.018 and 5.424 (mean = 2.31), Sortino ratios from 0.682 to 7.070 (mean = 3.12), and Calmar ratios spanning 2.398 to 59.281 (mean = 18.7). Classification metrics revealed precision rates of 59.5%-95.2% (mean = 72.8%) with recall rates of 3.4%-78.1% (mean = 44.6%) across diverse market conditions. Monte Carlo validation (n = 1,001 trials) and walk-forward analysis confirmed statistical significance (p < 0.001) and out-of-sample robustness. These results substantially exceed conventional risk management benchmarks and provide empirical support for coherence-based systemic risk detection.

AI.tldr: 本文对当前风险检测套件（CIX）进行了全面的实证验证，这是一个基于Balantium框架理论构建的确定性分析框架，通过场论变换量化系统性相干性衰减来预测金融不稳定。经过25年市场数据的回测，CIX在预测11次重大金融危机方面表现出卓越性能，预测提前期达75-250天，各项风险调整收益指标显著优于传统风险模型。
AI.research_question: CIX框架是否能有效预测金融系统性风险？其预测性能是否优于传统风险模型？
AI.motivation: 传统风险模型依赖随机假设或机器学习方法，存在局限性。需要开发基于系统性共振、相干性和反馈理论的新型风险检测框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: Balantium框架的系统性共振、相干性和反馈理论，通过场论变换量化系统性相干性衰减。
AI.method: 采用25年市场数据进行全面回测，涵盖11次重大金融危机，使用蒙特卡洛验证和滚动分析确认统计显著性和样本外稳健性。
AI.theory_contributions: 为基于相干性的系统性风险检测提供了实证支持，验证了场论变换在金融风险预测中的有效性。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了优于传统风险模型的预测工具，为金融机构提供了更早、更准确的风险预警能力。

detail.title: Cross‑Border Acknowledgment of Academic Obstruction: A Systemic QA Dossier on Access Denial, Policy Inconsistency, and Accreditation Risk
detail.abstract: This dossier synthesizes documentary evidence of administrative obstruction affecting access to compulsory anatomy practicals for a registered FM/CV student and the use of degraded examination specimens, alongside contradictory enforcement of internal policy. Following exhaustion of national remedies, the matter was acknowledged by international bodies (WFME/FAIMER redirection to MAB; ECFMG acknowledgment) and by the Irish DFHEARIS, establishing cross‑border visibility. The dossier maps the fact pattern to Hungarian/EU law (Act CCIV/2011, Act XXV/2023; EU Charter arts 14/21/47) and QA standards (ESG 1.2/1.3/1.6; WFME 3.1/3.4), and proposes corrective actions: independent resource audit, codified/published rules applied consistently, retrospective academic remedy for exams held with substandard materials, and confirmation of lawful access for FM/CV registrants.

AI.tldr: 该文件记录了匈牙利某医学院对FM/CV注册学生在解剖实践课程准入方面的行政阻碍、使用劣质考试标本以及内部政策执行不一致的问题，并提出了基于匈牙利/EU法律和QA标准的纠正措施。
AI.research_question: 如何通过法律和质量管理标准解决医学院对特定学生群体的行政阻碍和不公平待遇问题？
AI.motivation: 保护FM/CV注册学生的教育权利，确保解剖实践课程的公平准入和考试材料的质量标准。
AI.theoretical_framework: 匈牙利法律（Act CCIV/2011, Act XXV/2023）、欧盟基本权利宪章（第14/21/47条）、欧洲高等教育质量保证标准（ESG 1.2/1.3/1.6）、世界医学教育联合会标准（WFME 3.1/3.4）。
AI.method: 文献证据综合分析法，将事实模式映射到法律和质量标准框架。
AI.findings: 确认存在行政阻碍、劣质考试标本使用和政策执行不一致的问题，国际机构和爱尔兰DFHEARIS已承认该问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了教育权利保护与质量管理标准的交叉分析框架，为类似案例提供法律和标准依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出具体纠正措施：独立资源审计、规范化规则发布、对使用不合格材料的考试进行学术补救、确认FM/CV注册学生的合法准入权利。

title: Signposts of Success: Evaluating Ontario’s Elementary Schools
affiliations: C.D. Howe Institute

detail.title: Signposts of Success: Evaluating Ontario’s Elementary Schools
detail.abstract:
• This report marks the return of the Signposts of Success series after more than a decade. Building on earlier editions (2005, 2007, 2012), it provides an updated, evidence-based analysis of Ontario elementary school test-score results using three years of recent data. Unlike other rankings, Signposts adjusts for student socioeconomic backgrounds and avoids simplistic scoring, offering a fairer measure of school effectiveness.
  • Socioeconomic background matters but does not fully determine outcomes. Many schools outperform expectations, showing that effective practices can raise student achievement in both literacy and math across diverse communities. Social and economic status factors explain more of the variation in math outcomes than in literacy, and the predictors of success shift between Grade 3 and Grade 6.
  • System and board structures influence results. Catholic and French-language schools systematically achieve better outcomes than public schools, particularly in literacy, while Grade 6 transitions to middle school weaken performance. At the board level, several French-language, Catholic, and select public boards consistently produce higher results, highlighting the role of board-level practices.

AI.research_question: 如何公平评估安大略省小学的效能？社会经济背景、学校类型和董事会结构如何影响学生学业成果？

AI.method: 基于安大略省小学三年测试成绩数据的实证分析，采用统计调整方法控制社会经济背景变量

title: A Theoretical Model of the Biological Consequence of Reality Instability in Trauma: Inversion
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: A Theoretical Model of the Biological Consequence of Reality Instability in Trauma: Inversion
detail.abstract: This paper advances a theoretical revision to trauma science by modeling the survival brain's response to ontological rupture as a biological protocol rather than a purely psychological reaction. We propose that when the organism encounters incoherence in lived reality, the core survival system, lacking access to abstraction, reflective cognition, or affect regulation, internalizes the rupture as an immediate, existential threat. This initiates a non-volitional override comprising three interrelated processes: (1) inversion of fault localization to the self, a process we term operator inversion (a novel construct introduced in this model); (2) narrowed attentional focus on internal triage, termed myopic triage; and (3) persistent activation until resolution, termed persistence protocol. When the source of rupture is external (e.g., another mind or a destabilized relational environment), the protocol cannot access the locus of repair, producing an open-loop survival state that overrides higher cognition and resists psychological closure. We outline clinical implications that emphasize restoring ontological coherence through body-based and regulatory interventions rather than solely cognitive strategies and propose research directions to empirically test the model's neurobiological and phenomenological claims. By reframing prolonged "insanity" as a biologically mediated experience of reality failure (non-clinical usage), this framework integrates trauma science, neuroscience, and phenomenology to explain treatment-resistant presentations under conditions of chronic reality destabilization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了创伤科学的一个理论修正，将生存大脑对本体断裂的反应建模为生物协议而非纯粹心理反应。该模型解释了当生物体遭遇现实不连贯时，核心生存系统会启动非自主性覆盖，包括操作者反转、近视分诊和持久协议三个过程，导致治疗抵抗性创伤表现。
AI.research_question: 如何从生物协议的角度重新理解创伤反应，特别是治疗抵抗性创伤在慢性现实失稳条件下的表现？
AI.motivation: 传统创伤科学主要从心理学角度解释创伤反应，但无法充分解释治疗抵抗性创伤表现。本文旨在通过整合神经科学和现象学，提供更全面的理论框架。

AI.method: 理论建模和概念分析，提出操作者反转、近视分诊、持久协议三个核心概念。
AI.findings: 本体断裂会触发生存系统的非自主性覆盖，当修复源外部时会产生开环生存状态，覆盖高级认知并抵抗心理闭合。

title: Quantum-Classical Gap Indicators for Economic Mechanism Design
affiliations: Universidade Federal de Mato Grosso

detail.title: Quantum-Classical Gap Indicators for Economic Mechanism Design
detail.abstract: We introduce a mathematical framework for quantifying coordination inefficiencies in economic mechanisms by comparing classical game-theoretic equilibria with their quantum counterparts. Our central contribution is a suite of indicators-particularly the Quantum-Classical Gap (∆ QC) and the Quantum Opportunity Index (QOI)-that measure the efficiency loss from classical strategic constraints. These indicators reveal that major economic mechanisms leave 15-40% of potential welfare unrealized due to coordination failures invisible to classical analysis. We prove that quantum equilibria, which exploit entanglement to achieve correlations violating Bell inequalities, establish theoretical upper bounds for mechanism efficiency. While quantum games are not implementable with current technology, they guide practical redesigns: mechanisms inspired by quantum insights capture 60-90% of the theoretical improvement using classical tools like contingent contracts and controlled information revelation. Applications to auctions, public goods provision, and bilateral trade demonstrate potential welfare gains exceeding $100 billion annually in existing markets. The framework transforms mechanism design from accepting Nash inefficiencies as inevitable to measuring them against absolute theoretical limits and systematically recovering the losses.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个数学框架，通过比较经典博弈论均衡与量子对应物来量化经济机制中的协调低效。核心贡献是量子-经典差距(∆ QC)和量子机会指数(QOI)等指标，这些指标揭示了主要经济机制由于经典分析无法识别的协调失败而损失15-40%的潜在福利。
AI.research_question: 如何量化经济机制中的协调低效率？量子博弈能否为机制效率建立理论上限？
AI.motivation: 经典博弈论中的纳什均衡存在固有的协调低效，但缺乏系统方法来衡量这些效率损失的理论上限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 量子博弈论、贝尔不等式、纠缠理论、机制设计理论
AI.method: 数学框架构建、量子-经典均衡比较分析、指标开发、应用案例研究（拍卖、公共物品提供、双边贸易）
AI.findings: 主要经济机制损失15-40%潜在福利；量子均衡为效率建立理论上限；基于量子洞察的经典机制改进可捕获60-90%的理论改善
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了协调低效的量化框架，提出了∆ QC和QOI等新指标，证明了量子均衡作为效率理论上限
AI.practical_contributions: 为现有市场提供了超过1000亿美元的年福利增益潜力，指导了使用或有合同和控制信息揭示等经典工具的机制重新设计

title: The Impacts of Development on Energy Transition
affiliations: West Virginia University and West Virginia University - Davis College of Agriculture, Forestry, and Consumer Sciences

detail.title: The Impacts of Development on Energy Transition

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors thank Shishir Shakya, PhD, for his initial contributions in shaping the ideas for this paper, for guidance on applying the instrumental variable approach, and for suggesting the use of the pathogen index as the instrumental variable.

detail.abstract: We measure the impact of country's development on its energy transition. Economic development is often linked to the cultural values of a nation. The Parasite-Stress Theory of Values (PSTV) suggests that regional variation in infectious diseases influences a nation's culture and values. Drawing on rich and thought-provoking literature on the PSTV, we employ a two-stage least squares method to examine the potential relationship between the historical prevalence of infectious diseases and a nation's cultural influence on development and then predict the level of the energy transition based upon a country's development. The first stage result shows statistically significant, negative impacts from the prevalence of historic infectious diseases on development. The second stage results reveal that development's positive impact on energy transition to renewable energy within a country becomes stronger after implementation of the Kyoto Protocol and the Paris Agreement.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨国家发展对能源转型的影响，基于寄生虫压力价值理论，采用两阶段最小二乘法分析历史传染病流行率通过文化价值观影响国家发展，进而预测能源转型水平。研究发现历史传染病对发展有显著负向影响，而京都议定书和巴黎协定后发展对可再生能源转型的积极作用增强。
AI.research_question: 国家发展如何影响其能源转型？历史传染病流行率是否通过文化价值观影响国家发展？
AI.motivation: 经济发屐常与国家文化价值观相关，寄生虫压力价值理论认为传染病流行影响国家文化和价值观，进而影响发展路径和能源转型决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 寄生虫压力价值理论（PSTV） - 认为地区传染病变异影响国家文化和价值观
AI.method: 两阶段最小二乘法（2SLS） - 第一阶段分析历史传染病对发展的影响，第二阶段分析发展对能源转型的影响
AI.findings: 1）历史传染病流行率对国家发展有显著负向影响；2）京都议定书和巴黎协定实施后，发展对可再生能源转型的积极影响增强
AI.theory_contributions: 将寄生虫压力价值理论应用于能源转型研究，拓展了文化价值观对发展路径影响的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供依据，表明国际气候协议能强化发展对能源转型的促进作用，有助于制定更有效的能源政策

title: The Impact of Population Ageing on Residents' Savings Rate: An Empirical Study Based on Provincial Panel Data in China
affiliations: Longdong University, Longdong University and Longdong University

detail.title: The Impact of Population Ageing on Residents' Savings Rate: An Empirical Study Based on Provincial Panel Data in China
detail.abstract: Household savings are a crucial driver of economic development. Since the 21st century, China has experienced rapid economic growth alongside a rising household savings rate and deepening population ageing. Using panel data from 330 prefecture-level cities in China (2013–2024), this study constructs a regression model to examine how population ageing affects savings rates and their regional heterogeneity. The findings indicate: (1) Ageing displays significant urban-rural and regional disparities, with more pronounced ageing in rural and developed areas; (2) Ageing and child dependency jointly elevate savings rates—each percentage-point increase in ageing raises savings by 23%–53%; (3) The effect is strongest in the east (β = 0.4021), followed by the west (β = 0.3629), and weakest in the centre (β = 0.2487), reflecting regional economic and social security differences. Policy recommendations include tiered pension reforms in the east, inflation-linked subsidies in the west, and improved social security coordination in central regions, alongside innovative tools like longevity bonds and childcare tax deductions to lower savings and support sustainable growth.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于中国330个地级市面板数据，分析人口老龄化对储蓄率的影响及区域异质性。研究发现老龄化与儿童抚养比共同推高储蓄率，且东部地区影响最强，中部最弱，反映了区域经济和社会保障差异。

title: Bridging the Divide: How Dual-Background Leaders Unlock Returnee Innovation in Politically Connected Chinese Firms
affiliations: University of Texas at Dallas, University of Illinois, Urbana-Champaign, Towson University, Nanjing University, University of International Business and Economics, University of Maryland - R.H. Smith School of Business and Soochow University

detail.title: Bridging the Divide: How Dual-Background Leaders Unlock Returnee Innovation in Politically Connected Chinese Firms
detail.abstract: This study examines how firm leadership diversity influences innovation, focusing on the interplay between returnee leaders-those with international experience-and politically connected leaders. While returnee leaders introduce globally derived innovation practices, their efforts often clash with the state-aligned agendas of politically connected leaders. By integrating bridging mechanisms into upper echelons theory, we introduce dual-background leaders-executives with both political and international experience-to bridge these divergent cognitive logics. Through a longitudinal analysis of Chinese publicly listed firms from 2006 to 2016, we find that the positive effect of returnee leaders on innovation performance is significantly weakened in firms with high political connectivity, especially in the absence of dual-background leaders. Conversely, firms that effectively integrate dual-background leaders are better positioned to reconcile competing innovation agendas and unlock the synergistic potential of leadership diversity.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨企业领导层多样性如何影响创新，重点关注海归领导（具有国际经验）与政治关联领导之间的互动关系。研究发现，海归领导对创新绩效的积极影响在政治关联度高的企业中显著减弱，而拥有双背景领导（兼具政治和国际经验）的企业能够更好地协调竞争性创新议程。
AI.research_question: 企业领导层多样性如何影响创新绩效？海归领导与政治关联领导之间的互动关系如何？双背景领导在协调不同认知逻辑中发挥什么作用？
AI.motivation: 现有研究关注单一类型的领导背景对创新的影响，但忽视了不同类型领导（如海归领导与政治关联领导）之间的互动关系及其对企业创新的综合影响。

AI.method: 对中国上市公司2006-2016年的纵向数据分析
AI.findings: 1）海归领导对创新绩效的积极影响在政治关联度高的企业中显著减弱；2）双背景领导能够有效协调海归领导与政治关联领导之间的认知冲突；3）有效整合双背景领导的企业能够释放领导多样性的协同潜力

AI.practical_contributions: 为企业如何有效管理不同类型的领导、协调创新议程提供了实践指导，特别对新兴市场企业的国际化创新战略具有重要启示

title: Impacts of Consumption Loans and Social Security on Households Welfare in Kano Metropolis
affiliations: Bayero University Kano - Department of Economics and Bayero University Kano - Department of Economics

detail.title: Impacts of Consumption Loans and Social Security on Households Welfare in Kano Metropolis
detail.abstract: This research examines factors that affect households' consumption pattern in Kano metropolis. Kano metropolis has its unique socioeconomic and cultural settings which affect consumption activities of households. The study employs data gathered by means of questionnaire surveys carried out in Kano metropolis in 2023. The data was analysed using Tobit and exponential regression models. The findings of the study show that consumer loans and social security have positive impacts on household consumption. The results also show that food expenditure dominated consumption expenditure pattern, while cost of energy has negative effects on consumption. These findings have implications on government efforts to fight poverty, ensure food security and provide affordable energy to households. Therefore, government shall revitalize consumer loan schemes, boost assistance to the poor and provide cheaper alternatives means of energy such as renewable energy. Through understanding of factors that affect consumption and households' welfare, policymakers, researchers and stakeholders can develop good policies and strategies to deal with the challenges of poverty and welfare of households in Kano state and Nigeria at large.

title: Collateral, Redeployability, and Courts: A Unified Note
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Collateral, Redeployability, and Courts: A Unified Note
detail.abstract: I build a compact agency framework for collateral design under redeployability frictions and court regimes. Five core results emerge: (i) pledge liquidation states before continuation cash flows; (ii) non-verifiable collateral maintenance with private distress signals tightens financing constraints; (iii) borrower-friendly court splits shrink the implementable set and can raise bankruptcy probability; (iv) when buyer demand is elastic, ex-ante quantity caps on liquidation reduce price impact and raise investment and surplus; (v) loan size and collateral move monotonically with net worth and agency severity. Each statement is given with explicit equations and short proofs.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个紧凑的代理框架，研究在可重新部署摩擦和法院制度下的抵押品设计问题，提出了五个核心结果，涉及抵押品清算状态、非可验证抵押品维护、法院分割、清算数量限制以及贷款规模与抵押品的关系。
AI.research_question: 如何在可重新部署摩擦和不同法院制度下设计最优的抵押品安排？
AI.motivation: 研究抵押品设计在存在重新部署摩擦和不同法院制度时的最优安排，以解决融资约束和破产概率等问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于代理理论和抵押品可重新部署性的紧凑框架，考虑法院制度和私人困境信号的影响。
AI.method: 构建理论模型，通过明确的方程和简短证明推导五个核心结果。
AI.findings: （i）抵押品清算状态优先于持续现金流；（ii）非可验证抵押品维护加剧融资约束；（iii）借款人友好的法院分割缩小可实施集并可能增加破产概率；（iv）当买方需求弹性时，事前清算数量限制降低价格影响并增加投资和剩余；（v）贷款规模和抵押品与净价值和代理严重性单调相关。

title: Group Lending, Peer Monitoring, and Correlation Pitfalls: A Unified Note
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Group Lending, Peer Monitoring, and Correlation Pitfalls: A Unified Note
detail.abstract: Using the same notation and timing as in the companion note on collateral and courts, I derive conditions under which group lending with joint liability and peer monitoring expands financing capacity-and when positive correlation of project outcomes nullifies those gains. The framework produces four core results: (i) a pledging/implementation region with joint liability that nests individual lending as a boundary case; (ii) a minimal relational capital (discount factor) needed to sustain peer monitoring and repayment; (iii) a correlation threshold above which group enforcement loses bite and the model collapses to individual lending; (iv) an interior optimal group size balancing monitoring benefits against correlation-driven cascades. Equations are kept in the same style as the collateral note for seamless combination.

AI.tldr: 本文通过建立与抵押品和法院相关研究相同的模型框架，推导出团体贷款在何种条件下能够扩大融资能力，以及项目结果正相关何时会抵消这些收益。
